name: Dragon, Arcane
body:
ARCANE DRAGON, VERY YOUNG
CR 4

This purple dragon’s skin is embedded with vibrant gemstones which glow as he calls on arcane power.

XP 1,200
N Small dragon (arcane)
Init +0; Senses dragon senses; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 11, flat-footed 15 (+4 natural, +1 size)
hp 32 (5d12)
Fort +4, Ref +4, Will +4
Immune paralysis, sleep

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., fly 150 ft. (average)
Melee bite +6 (1d6), 2 claws +6 (1d4)
Special Attacks breath weapon (20-ft. cone, DC 12, 3d4 force, once per 1d4 rounds)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 5th; concentration +9)

2nd (5/day)—create pit (DC 17), glitterdust (DC 17)
1st (7/day)—charm person (DC 16), grease, magic missile, obscuring mist
0 (at will)—arcane mark, detect magic, flare (DC 14), light, mage hand, prestidigitation

STATISTICS

Str 11, Dex 10, Con 11, Int 14, Wis 10, Cha 19
Base Atk +5; CMB +4; CMD 14 (18 vs. trip)
Feats Spell Focus (conjuration), Spell Focus (enchantment), Wingover
Skills Appraise +10, Fly +8, Knowledge (arcana) +10, Knowledge (engineering) +10, Knowledge (history) +10, Knowledge (planes) +10, Spellcraft +10, Stealth +4, Use Magic Device +12
Languages Draconic, Common, Halfling, Elven

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Dragon Senses (Ex)

Dragons have darkvision 120 ft. and blindsense 60 ft. They see four times as well as a human in dim light and twice as well in normal light.
